title: AI Is Moving From Chat to Work
topic: AI is shifting from asking questions toward executing real work

scenes.headline:
AI is moving
from chat to work.
scenes.body: The key shift isn't only smarter answers. It's execution.

scenes.headline:
First:
ask.
scenes.body: AI answered. You still carried the workflow.

scenes.headline:
Then:
assist.
scenes.body: Draft, analyze, compare, code—the tool moved inside the task.

scenes.headline:
Now:
execute.
scenes.body: Agents and workflows can move from advice toward real action.

scenes.headline:
Prompting isn't
the whole skill.
scenes.body: Permissions, verification and workflow design become the advantage.

scenes.headline:
What can AI
safely finish?
scenes.body: That's the question that matters as chat becomes work.

publish.title: AI Is Moving From Chat to Work #Shorts
publish.caption:
OpenAI's recent usage and enterprise reports point to a broader shift: AI is moving from answering questions toward doing work inside real workflows. The next skill isn't only prompting. It's designing what AI can safely finish end-to-end.
